pages._text: Stars begin to shine. Maryam watches the fox step into the garden and lift its nose to the same moon.
Paper can carry the fox there. She steps back from the glass and reaches for the first sheet.
Out in the garden she gathers the paper alone. The fox sits close and watches the sheets.
Fold by fold the paper holds its shape in her hands. The fox sits very still and watches.
She gives the rocket a gentle push. It rises with the fox and she watches her idea fly.
The rocket settles on the moon. Maryam sees the fox step out under the quiet sky.
Maryam pictures the fox standing there now. Stars shine above the rocket the way she hoped.
Down comes the rocket again. Maryam watches the fox step out and the stars hold every wish in place.
